status: WITHDRAWN FROM PROMOTION — first-pass numerical results are retained as historical exploratory artifacts only; do not cite them as a valid spatially blocked holdout, a Ben-David divergence bound, a score estimate, or expected leaderboard performance.

reasons.finding: The pseudo-hidden truth was sampled from catalogue pixels, then reconstruct_shadow(emission, hidden) added prediction at sampled hidden locations when an emission was within the selected radius. The scored prediction therefore used held-out truth coordinates. The radius was swept after comparison with owner-reported scores. This is direct label leakage and test-set calibration, not validation.

Confirmation seeds 0 and 1 were reused from exploratory operator selection, and the trim was selected after the budget sweep. The nominal fold-by-seed cells are not independent confirmation, and frozen criteria do not repair the leaked/selected evaluation design.

The pseudo-truth was sampled from the visible catalogue while H27/H36/H38 artifacts remove pixels near that same catalogue. The construction is structurally biased against those artifact families. A loss cannot refute H36/H38; a within-family pruning gain cannot validate transfer to private faults.

The former source/target regions were well/spring-record-density quantiles, not named fields. The 27,092 source CSV rows include repeated attributes at 12,570 unique cells. A random row split ignored spatial autocorrelation, the fitted discriminator was not shown to match the model's HΔH class, and no valid finite-sample term or lambda (joint-label error) was supplied. The archived AUC is not a Ben-David divergence estimate and neither licenses nor refutes field transfer. The active runner is now fail-closed.

The previous hand-coded ROC AUC mixed tied-rank conventions; associated numbers are archived and not reused. Earlier arithmetic K/Th, U/K and K*U/Th transforms were calculated from owner-mirror uint8 encodings without verified per-band scale/offset metadata, so they were not established as physical ratios. Any resulting 'below chance' claim is withdrawn. The active screen now uses sklearn and is explicitly exploratory against owner-mirror SGMC map faults, not competition holdout evidence.

First-pass implementation and measurements predated the ranked hypothesis registry. The current three-hypothesis list is retrospective, not a preregistration. The historical confirmation plan is preserved but explicitly withdrawn.

The previous live-score inversion and reconstructed DTI scale used owner-reported score/file pairings and a hidden-population model that could not be checked against private labels. Combined with the truth-conditioned radius reconstruction, those estimates are not valid predictions or a calibrated validation instrument and have been removed from the active score registry.

consequence: No +0.00601 promotion claim, channel-ranking promotion claim, reconstructed leaderboard/DTI score, hidden-truth-size inversion, or domain-transfer verdict is treated as evidence. Experimental TIFFs and stale upload-note files were removed from docs/downloads. The only recommended download is the D2.8 owner-mirror reference; its 0.2600 association is owner-reported and score-to-file identity remains unconfirmed.
